Show frequently changed files and directories in recent commits

Usage:
  ycy git heat [flags]

Flags:
  -d, --days string     Number of recent days to inspect
  -h, --help            help for heat
  -n, --limit string    Number of recent commits to inspect
  -q, --query string    Highlight files or directories that contain text
  -r, --relative-time   Show Changed at as relative time
  -s, --sort string     Sort by count or path
  -t, --type string     Report type: files or directories

Global Flags:
      --log-format string   Diagnostic format: text or json
      --log-level string    Log level: debug, info, warn, or error
      --quiet               Only emit error diagnostics (short form: -q)
  -v, --verbose             Enable debug diagnostics
